record.hypothesis: For all four datasets, replace the batch-wide valid-position loss average with a per-history average: compute each sampled history's mean softplus(-(positive_score-negative_score)) over valid targets, then average those means across the batch. This gives sampled users equal objective weight instead of letting longer histories dominate, potentially improving user-averaged HR@10. Preserve sampled pairs, features, embeddings, HSTU topology, scoring/readout, optimizer, scheduler and training settings.
